title: Enchanted Golden Apple Crafting!
description: This project adds the old Enchanted Golden Apple recipe to the game.
body:
# What this plugin does
This plugin adds the old crafting recipe for The Enchanted Golden Apple. It is very easy to use and there is no other plugins needed for this to work.

**Are there other plugin that makes things craftable that usally arent?**

Yes, there are many more plugins. Just click on the profile "ItzzNotVoid" on this project to see more. If you dont see any its because I haven't made them yet. (Written 5/28/2026)
